children.helpText: The timeline shows you all the Failed or Slow CRUD operations , We have sections below to troubleshoot / detect all the major error types

children.header:
This table shows all the fabric clusters the resources were created in. 
All Fabricator failovers are logged below, verify which tenant was in that cluster from the list above and then open the dashboard in the TSG below to get more details.

selectedProperties.friendlyName: Was FRIC sent but Exception occured

children.header: Important: This tab will have results the cause was due to container issues or delayed FRIC result.  The issue may still be occurring at networking side review this TSG: https://aka.ms/CCSupNetworkingInternalError

The table shows any container(s) stuck in Unknown state for more than 1 minute. Longer times usually can be due to various reasons like workflow blockage / Fabric Failover etc. Long times before the container comes to a started state can also result in CRP operation timeouts.
children.helpText: Tip: If the Container  Creation Time (Creation Time below) is earlier than the startime specified in ASI, adjust the start time to be greater than the Container Creation Time to get a full picture if how long the container was stuck in Unknown.

children.header: The list below has extensions that consistently reported long times in PollForExtensionstatus and had  "Transitioning" or "NotReady" states over several operations, it may not mean that the extensions failed or are problematic, see if you see a final Failed or NotReady status and use this as a guide to aid you in further troubleshooting.
